mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_favorite (user_id, show_id, group_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{showId}, #{groupId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND show_id = #{showId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND show_id = #{showId}

SELECT uf.id, uf.user_id, uf.show_id, uf.group_id, uf.create_time, uf.update_time, s.id AS s_id, s.name AS s_name, s.description AS s_description, s.category_id AS s_category_id, c.name AS s_category_name, s.city_code AS s_city_code, ct.name AS s_city_name, s.address AS s_address, s.poster_url AS s_poster_url, s.venue AS s_venue, s.status AS s_status, s.review_mode AS s_review_mode, s.avg_rating AS s_avg_rating, s.review_count AS s_review_count FROM user_favorite uf LEFT JOIN `show` s ON s.id = uf.show_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = s.category_id LEFT JOIN city ct ON ct.code = s.city_code WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.group_id = #{groupId} AND uf.group_id IS NULL ORDER BY uf.create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_favorite WHERE show_id = #{showId}
